whoWeAre.title: Who we are
desc: We bring over 15 years of international experience (United Kingdom) in smart home systems, high-end AV installations, and advanced building automation.

We design and deliver exclusive solutions that seamlessly integrate technology into a perfectly unified system—with a focus on comfort, design, and absolute reliability. We work with premium platforms such as Crestron, Crestron Home, Loxone, and Lutron, enabling intuitive control of lighting, audio, video, shading, and the entire property environment.

We integrate all technologies—from multimedia and lighting to energy management—into a single elegant and easy-to-use platform. The result is a space that responds to user needs and delivers a truly exceptional experience.

Our projects also include advanced property security solutions. We implement professional systems from brands such as Jablotron, Paradox, and Risco, access control solutions like Salto, and modern surveillance and networking technologies from Ubiquiti.
Every project is unique to us—we create tailored solutions that meet the highest standards of security, aesthetics, and technological excellence.

showroom.title: Smart Home Showroom
description: P&A Vision runs a smart home showroom where you can experience Crestron, Loxone, and Lutron systems live. In one place you'll see how lighting, shading, heating, and audio work together as a single connected ecosystem.

Try one-touch scene control for yourself – from a gentle morning wake-up to a full cinema evening. Feel firsthand how a smart home responds in real time and how seamlessly the technology blends into a luxury interior.

During your visit our specialists will design a solution tailored precisely to your home or apartment. We'll walk through integration options, budget, and installation – clearly and with no obligation.
Our showroom serves clients across Europe and is open by appointment. Book a time and discover a new standard of intelligent living with your own eyes.

office.title: Smart Office & Workspace
description: Transform your office into a productive, representative environment. P&A Vision integrates lighting, shading, climate, and audio/video into one system that adapts to your team's daily rhythm.
Launch automated scenes for meetings, presentations, or everyday work with a single touch. Conference rooms prepare themselves – lighting, blinds, and projection respond exactly when needed.
Smart control lowers running costs through automatic lighting and efficient temperature regulation. Monitor and manage everything clearly from one place.
We design and deliver solutions for offices and corporate spaces across Europe – reliably, elegantly, and with attention to detail.

familyHome.title: Smart Family Home
description: Create a home that takes care of the whole family. P&A Vision connects lighting, heating, shading, security, and entertainment into one intuitive system powered by Crestron, Loxone, and Lutron.
Morning and evening scenes, automated blinds, and zoned temperature control keep every room comfortable. The home anticipates your needs and saves energy without any manual adjustment.
Peace of mind comes first – control camera systems, smart locks, and access management from your phone, anywhere. Stay in touch with what's happening at home, even remotely.
We deliver smart family homes across Europe, with a solution tailored to your lifestyle and budget.

business.title: Smart Solutions for Business & Commercial Spaces
description: From hotels and restaurants to shops and showrooms – P&A Vision delivers professional automation for commercial spaces. Lighting, climate, audio, and access control work together as one reliable system.
Centralised management lets you control an entire venue from a single interface. Scenes for opening hours, events, and night mode run automatically on schedule.
Cut operating costs with smart energy management and gain real-time insight into your entire operation. The system scales together with your business.
We design and integrate solutions for businesses across Europe – with a focus on reliability, security, and a representative finish.
